callees.name: _is_metadata_sidecar
callees.pre_condition: fname is a filename string (basename only, not a full path) from a filesystem directory listing.
callees.post_condition: Returns True when fname matches the naming pattern of a metadata sidecar that accompanies an extracted function file (e.g., a .spec.json or .info.json suffix); returns False otherwise. The determination is based solely on the filename string and does not inspect file contents or filesystem metadata.
